name: E-commerce
summary: Product first, friction last: imagery leads, price and the add-to-cart action are always obvious, checkout is short and calm.
principles: Product imagery is the hero; UI chrome stays quiet and neutral.
Price, availability and the primary action are visible without scrolling on product pages.
Consistent product cards: same image ratio, same text structure, same alignment.
Trust signals near the decision: delivery, returns, secure payment.
Checkout removes everything that is not needed to pay.
structure_note: Header (logo, search, account, cart with count), category or collection grid, product detail page, cart, and a separate distraction-free checkout.

sections.name: Header
sections.purpose: Search, browse and reach the cart from anywhere.
guidance: Search is prominent (a field on desktop, an icon that opens a full-width field on mobile).
Cart icon with an item count badge; account and help links.
Category navigation in plain text; mega menus only for large catalogs, with images kept small.

sections.name: Product listing
guidance: Grid with a fixed image aspect ratio (for example 4:5), 2 columns on mobile, 3-4 on desktop.
Card: image, name (2 lines max), price in tabular numerals, optional rating and one badge at most (Sale, New).
Filters and sort in a sidebar on desktop and a bottom sheet on mobile; show the result count.

sections.name: Product detail
guidance: Gallery left (swipeable on mobile), buy box right: name, price, variant pickers, quantity, primary Add to cart, secondary Save.
Variant pickers show unavailable options as disabled with a reason; selected state is unmistakable.
Delivery estimate, returns policy and size guide near the button; long description and specs below in expandable sections.

platform_notes.android: Keep Add to cart in a bottom-anchored bar on long product pages.

sections.name: Cart
guidance: Line items with image, name, variant, quantity stepper, line price, remove (with undo).
Order summary with subtotal, delivery and total in tabular numerals; one primary Checkout button.
Show the free-delivery threshold progress as text plus a thin bar, not a gamified banner.

sections.name: Checkout
sections.purpose: Pay with confidence and minimum effort.
guidance: Remove site navigation; show progress (Delivery, Payment, Review) and an order summary.
Guest checkout first; express payment buttons at the top.
Inline validation, correct keyboard types and autocomplete attributes on every field.

sections.name: Order confirmation
guidance: Order number, delivery estimate, what happens next and a way to track or change the order.
No upsell wall before the confirmation details.

states.name: Out of stock
states.guidance: Say so clearly, offer notify-me or alternatives; never hide the price.

states.name: Empty cart
states.guidance: Short message and a way back to shopping (recently viewed or categories).

states.name: Payment error
states.guidance: Explain the problem in plain words, keep entered data, offer another method.

states.name: Loading
states.guidance: Image placeholders at the final aspect ratio so the grid never jumps.

states.name: No search results
states.guidance: Suggest spelling fixes, related categories and clear the active filters.

accessibility: Product images have descriptive alt text (what, color, angle).
Variant pickers are real radio groups with labels, not color-only swatches.
Prices are read with their currency; sale prices announce the original price too.
Focus moves sensibly when filters change and when items are added to the cart.
avoid: Pop-ups before the first product view
Inconsistent card heights and image ratios
Hidden fees revealed at the last step
